readout.basis: Sensor read-out unit of X-T20 2.11 at imaging control channel offset +0xc0: a started read-out sets status +0x20 bit 0 (write 1 clears), and its level interrupt 98 is high while that bit and the +0x1c bit 0 enable are set. The read-out begins at the first frame of the frame sync after the start write (section 5 driver 0xc35460): on that frame 0x17e6424 sends message 0x155c through 0x17c2f28 and the shot logs marker 0x04000000, and the firmware arms its return-to-live-view timer, whose step 0x03040000 follows 52 ms later. The camera's read-out ends 54.28 ms after 0x04000000 (shot D of 2026-11-01, timer step at 52.05 ms; 54.3 ms in the unplugged shot of 2026-10-22), so the ticks count 54.28 ms from that frame. No sensor data is written.

device.basis: Imaging control page of X-T20 2.11 section 5: +0x000 bit 0 is a run bit that 0xc33ec8 clears and then waits to read set (stopped); one register-bus channel at +0x200 (0xc345b4..0xc34864) sends a RAM frame 0x81 hi lo value (write) or 0x82 hi lo (read) to a select in configuration bits 8-12 and returns the reply byte in bits 15:8 of eight receive words at +0x21c. The imaging-side chip is a register file: the start-up writes a register and reads it back until it matches (seg6 0x17fa434). Commands and stops complete at once; what the chip does with the values is not modeled. Six transfer channels at +0x240 + 0x40*n (0xc34910..0xc34e94) are configured with mode, address and length words and started and stopped by +0x04 bit 0 (seg6 0x156a754 and 0x156a7b0). A reset pulse on +0x00 (0xc348d8) also stops a channel: seg6 0x16b7fbc resets the channels in its mask and then waits at 0x16b8118 for channel 0's run bit to read clear, which leaving SETUP for REC requires. Those words read back, and no data moves.
